in_marathi.name: Gitiksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom, knowledge, learning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gitiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gitiksha is derived from the Sanskrit words gitam (knowledge) and kshaya (to learn or study). This name signifies the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It is also associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of learning and knowledge.
